purpose: Compare Family H loss-avoidance and late-recovery-winner populations using only trajectory features observable by the second checkpoint.

Continuing to subdivide Family H would be threshold repair rather than a route to the 2023 portfolio gate.
The principal 2023 deficit is B02 JPY -12,459 while F05 is already JPY +3,180.
retained_findings: Failed rebound after a deep trough is more informative than persistence alone.
The magnitude is insufficient to solve the portfolio deficit.
B02 must be addressed to create a plausible 2023-positive architecture.
prohibited_reuse: Do not create Family I by adding rebound thresholds to Family H.
Do not keep partitioning F05 exit populations until a positive 2023 result appears.
